{"edits":[{"old":"    gmsh.model.mesh.generate(3)
    gmsh.model.mesh.setOrder(2)
","new":"    gmsh.model.mesh.generate(3)
    # Use straight-sided quadratic tetrahedra. Projecting midside nodes
    # onto the CAD at this mesh size inverted elements near small features.
    # Midpoint geometry retains the quadratic displacement approximation
    # and converges geometrically as the underlying mesh is refined.
    gmsh.option.setNumber("Mesh.SecondOrderLinear", 1)
    gmsh.model.mesh.setOrder(2)
    _, volume_element_tags, _ = gmsh.model.mesh.getElements(3)
    element_tags = np.concatenate(volume_element_tags)
    determinants = np.asarray(gmsh.model.mesh.getElementQualities(
        element_tags, "minDetJac"))
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(determinants)) or np.any(determinants <= 0):
        raise RuntimeError("Mesh contains nonpositive quadratic element Jacobians")
    logs.append("LEVEL %d: straight-sided quadratic geometry; minimum Jacobian determinant %.12g mm^3"
                % (level, determinants.min()))
